Supply, price & fees

  • OpenBook: 78,261 Quote and 21,739 Settle maximum.
  • FillOut: 31,304 Quote and 8,696 Settle maximum.
  • Observed base mint price: 0.0002 ETH per part, plus the displayed platform fee and network gas.
  • Observed marketplace fee: 1% of the sale price, deducted from seller proceeds. Network gas is separate.

Permissions & money flow

Each Parts contract is owned by its collection’s Desk contract. Minting is limited by fixed supply caps. The reviewed Desk exposes purchases, not arbitrary owner minting.

Desk owners can withdraw accumulated base mint payments to the fixed treasury. Platform fees go to that treasury during purchase. The gas-equivalent platform fee is calculated by the interface; the contract accepts a caller-supplied fee and does not independently enforce that policy.

Both Desk and Market owner/treasury getters returned 0x7734306b68ffa63b03ed6e3aa05ed72a63106b71. Multisignature controls for this address have not been established by this review.

Market sellers escrow listed parts and can cancel their own active listings to recover unsold parts. A purchase pays the treasury fee and seller, then transfers parts. The reviewed source has no owner-only listing seizure, fee setter, pause or market withdrawal function.

Creating a circuit is permanent

Creating a circuit NFT permanently locks its Quote and Settle parts. There is no dismantle or part-recovery operation in the reviewed circuit logic. The NFT can be transferred; its underlying parts remain locked.

The reviewed circuit logic has no owner/admin role. No proxy upgrade or pause mechanism appears in the reviewed contracts. These findings do not cover website administration, compromised wallets or future contracts.

Source matching is not proof that a contract is free of vulnerabilities, and constructor execution and historical transactions were not independently reproduced.

Automated security checks

Slither 0.11.6 completed an unfiltered scan. Its High/Medium records concern intentional OpenZeppelin math operations reviewed as false positives. A Low reentrancy warning in circuit creation and the remaining limitations are documented; this is not a zero-findings or independent-audit claim.

Read the static analysis report · Metadata resolution · Full transparency report

Local behavior tests

Local tests passed for reentrancy attempts, rejected payments and token deliveries, unauthorized cancellation and withdrawal, mint pricing and supply limits. They use an isolated local chain, without mainnet transactions. Production contract code was not changed. These tests cover specific scenarios and do not guarantee absence of vulnerabilities.

Read the behavior test coverage and limitations

VRAM & rewards

VRAM, challenges and mining rewards remain planned features. This review does not deploy a token, activate rewards or promise returns. Future contracts require their own review.
